<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ships its dense weights in FP8 with a fixed `[32, 32]` quantization block, so every dense projection is a blockwise FP8 GEMM (Triton `w8a8_block_fp8_matmul_triton`, with a DeepGEMM fast path on Hopper). That Triton kernel tiles only M and N, never K. At decode-sized M the grid is almost empty: `M=1, N=1792, K=5120`, `BLOCK_M=16, BLOCK_N=32` gives `grid = (ceil(1/16)*ceil(1792/32), 1, 1) = (56, 1, 1)`, and each of those 56 CTAs walks the full K loop. H20-3e has 78 SMs, so most of the device idles and this GEMV sits in the mid-30 us range.

H20-3e has no MXFP8 hardware path, so the block-32 FP8 GEMM itself has to fill the GPU. Splitting K across CTAs fixes the occupancy. Baseline: **94.1 tok/s** aggregate decode at M=1 on 8x H20-3e, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP8/EP8.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/kernels/jit/csrc/gemm/fp8_block32_sm90.cuh` — SM90 WGMMA block-[32, 32] FP8 GEMM. WGMMA atom K is 32; stock CUTLASS SM90 scales only after four atoms (K=128), this kernel multiplies the fp32 group scale after **every** atom, matching Triton.
  - One CTA owns 64 output rows x 8 tokens. `choose_split_k` returns the largest divisor of `k/32` that is `<= min(~8 grid-waves, k/128, k/32)`, so a split is always a multiple of the 32-element scale group and keeps >= 128 K elements.
  - Split-K partials are summed by a second reduce kernel.
  - Example `N=1792, K=5120, M=2`: 160 scale groups, 28 CTAs unsplit, target `ceil(78*8/28)=23`, largest divisor of 160 below 23 is 20 -> `grid (28, 20, 1)`, 560 CTAs at 256 K each.
  - A 64x128 variant (`fp8_block32_sm90_large`) exists for prefill-sized M; the serving dispatch caps at M <= 32, so the serving path uses only the 8-token split-K variant.
- `python/sglang/kernels/ops/gemm/fp8_block32_sm90.py` — JIT wrapper, `fp8_block32_gemm`, `_is_h20_3e` gate, `use_fp8_block32_gemm` eligibility check. `.../gemm/__init__.py` exports it.
- `python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/fp8_utils.py`:
  - DeepGEMM fallback redirects to the new kernel at M <= 8.
  - Triton backend redirects to the new kernel at M <= 32.
  - Both require: NVIDIA H20-3e, batch-invariant mode off, `weight_scale.dtype == float32`, `output_dtype == bfloat16`, `block_size == [32, 32]`, `input_scale is None`. Everything else is unchanged.
- Tests: `test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_fp8_block32_sm90.py` (vs Triton, M/K sweep, split-K path) and `test/registered/kernels/ops/quantization/test_fp8_block_gemm_configs.py` (dispatch coverage).

## Accuracy Tests

All 330 dense FP8 GEMM weights of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, new kernel vs `w8a8_block_fp8_matmul_triton`, bf16 output (requirement: RMSE < 1e-3):

| M | max_abs | RMSE | element mismatch |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.03125 | 1.774e-04 | 0.179% |
| 2 | 0.125 | 1.834e-04 | 0.176% |
| 4 | 0.0625 | 1.752e-04 | 0.175% |
| 8 | 0.0625 | 1.794e-04 | 0.175% |
| 16 | 0.0625 | 1.750e-04 | 0.177% |

Differences are one bf16 ulp on the largest magnitudes. `attn.wo_a`, `attn.wo_b`, `attn.wq_b` and `ffn.shared_experts.*` are bit-identical. Largest per-role deviations: `attn.indexer.wq_b` (RMSE 8.6e-04 to 9.8e-04) and `attn.wkv` (7.6e-04 to 8.6e-04), both in `kv_source_layer_ids` / `index_source_layer_ids` layers.

End-to-end (same server flags):

| Benchmark | Baseline | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K, 200 single-shot | 97.50% | 97.50% (avg output 127.2 -> 124.0 tokens) |
| AIME25, 20, temp 0, 1 repeat | 95.0% | 100% |
| AIME25, 20, temp 0.7 | 99.69% | 99.06% (within sampling noise) |
| GPQA pass@1 | - | 93.12% (published reference 90.9%) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8x NVIDIA H20-3e (SM90, 78 SMs), TP8 / EP8, `--moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --moe-a2a-backend none`, SGLang v0.5.22.

Decode throughput (`benchmark_m.py`, 1-token prompt, 256 output tokens, aggregate tok/s):

| M | Baseline | This PR | Delta | New kernel |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 94.12 | 107.03 | +13.7% | yes |
| 2 | 169.29 | 184.74 | +9.1% | yes |
| 4 | 297.12 | 317.38 | +6.8% | yes |
| 8 | 497.05 | 535.82 | +7.8% | yes |
| 16 | 745.86 | 800.88 | +7.4% | yes |
| 32 | 1022.32 | 1063.16 | +4.0% | yes |
| 64 | 1219.19 | 1261.55 | +3.5% | no |
| 128 | 1379.00 | 1443.30 | +4.7% | no |
| 256 | 1457.86 | 1486.96 | +2.0% | no |
| 512 | 1456.18 | 1487.04 | +2.1% | no |

M > 32 is not dispatched to the new kernel; those rows are run-to-run variance.

End-to-end (evalscope):

| Case | Output tok/s | Total tok/s | Avg TTFT ms | Avg TPOT ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1024->4096, p1 baseline | 92.95 | 22.65 | 197.39 | 10.71 |
| 1024->4096, p1 this PR | **105.66** (+13.7%) | **25.74** (+13.6%) | **193.71** (-1.9%) | **9.42** (-12.0%) |
| 32768->512, p1 baseline | 43.64 | 2790.73 | 6219.58 | 10.79 |
| 32768->512, p1 this PR | **46.24** (+6.0%) | **2956.76** (+5.9%) | **6220.73** (+0.0%) | **9.50** (-12.0%) |
| 32768->512, p30 baseline | 75.69 | 4840.41 | 95231.16 | 210.60 |
| 32768->512, p30 this PR | **76.70** (+1.3%) | **4905.38** (+1.3%) | **94096.02** (-1.2%) | **207.61** (-1.4%) |

Single-stream improves most (decode TPOT ~-12%); at p=30 decode is bound elsewhere.

Profiling: NCU on `M=1, N=1792, K=5120` shows much higher compute utilization in the main kernel; the K split turns 56 serial CTAs into 560 CTAs (`grid (28,20,1)`, 256 K per split, ~8 waves on 78 SMs) and device time drops from the mid-30 us range to about **10 us**. The reduce kernel costs one fp32 pass over `split_k x M x N` and is not visible end-to-end.

Rejected alternative - Triton `SPLIT_K=16` (raises occupancy but is slower than this kernel and ~equal to baseline):

| M | Baseline | Triton `SPLIT_K=16` | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 94.12 | 93.67 | 107.03 |
| 2 | 169.29 | 168.78 | 184.74 |
| 4 | 297.12 | 296.58 | 317.38 |
| 8 | 497.05 | 499.60 | 535.82 |
| 16 | 745.86 | 750.74 | 800.88 |

`SPLIT_K` only accepts powers of two, so it cannot land near 8 waves while dividing the 160 scale groups; `choose_split_k` picks 20. It also pays a full fp32 partials buffer plus a reduce without folding the group scale into the mainloop.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -605,6 +605,23 @@ def kimi_k3_tiny_gemm(x: torch.Tensor, w: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
         target="sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.fp8_kernel:w8a8_block_fp8_matmul",
     )
 )
+register_kernel(
+    KernelSpec(
+        op="gemm.fp8_block32_sm90",
+        backend=KernelBackend.JIT,
+        target="sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.fp8_block32_sm90:fp8_block32_gemm",
+        capabilities=_SM90,
+        format_signature=FormatSignature(
+            supported_dtypes=("float8_e4m3fn",),
+            description=(
+                "C[M,N] = act_fp8[M,K] @ weight_fp8[N,K].T with fp32 block-[32, 32] "
+                "scales applied after every K=32 WGMMA atom. Serving dispatch is "
+                "NVIDIA H20-3e only."
+            ),
+        ),
+        description="Block-32 FP8 GEMM for NVIDIA H20-3e (SM90 JIT).",
+    )
+)
 register_kernel(
     KernelSpec(
         op="gemm.w8a8_block_fp8_matmul_triton",

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+"""SM90 block-[32, 32] FP8 GEMM for NVIDIA H20-3e.
+
+WGMMA atom K is 32. The stock CUTLASS SM90 blockwise mainloop scales only
+after four atoms (K=128). This kernel multiplies the fp32 group scale after
+every atom, matching the Triton ``w8a8_block_fp8_matmul`` fallback.
+
+The serving dispatch enables it only on NVIDIA H20-3e. Other SM90 GPUs keep
+the Triton kernel. Decode-sized M uses an 8-token tile plus K split so the
+grid fills an H20-3e (78 SMs). Prefill-sized M uses a 64x128 tile; the
+8-token tile reloads the weight once per 8 rows and loses to Triton there.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_fp8_block32_sm90_module() -> Module:
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 9:
+        raise RuntimeError("fp8_block32_sm90 requires an SM90 GPU")
+    return load_jit(
+        "fp8_block32_sm90",
+        cuda_files=["gemm/fp8_block32_sm90.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("run", "fp8_block32_sm90"),
+            ("run_large", "fp8_block32_sm90_large"),
+        ],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=[
+            "-O3",
+            "-DNDEBUG",
+            "-DCUTE_USE_PACKED_TUPLE=1",
+            "-DCUTLASS_ENABLE_TENSOR_CORE_MMA=1",
+        ],
+        extra_dependencies=["cutlass"],
+    )
+
+
+def legal_split_k(k: int, split_k: int) -> bool:
+    """True when every split is a non-empty multiple of the group size 32."""
+    return split_k >= 1 and k % split_k == 0 and (k // split_k) % 32 == 0
+
+
+def choose_split_k(n: int, k: int, sm_count: int, m: int = 1) -> int:
+    """Largest legal split at or below ~8 grid-waves, with at least 128 K per split.
+
+    On H20-3e the K=5120 square GEMV was bandwidth-bound at one CTA per 64 rows
+    (split 1, ~80 CTAs). Splitting K into 8 raised the grid to ~8 waves and
+    moved device time from the mid-30 us range to ~10 us. Smaller shapes are
+    capped so a split still owns 128 K elements (four WGMMA atoms). Token tiles
+    of 8 already add grid z, so a wide M does not also split K.
+    """
+    groups = k // 32
+    tiles_n = max(1, (n + 63) // 64)
+    tiles_m = max(1, (m + 7) // 8)
+    tiles = tiles_n * tiles_m
+    target = max(1, (sm_count * 8 + tiles - 1) // tiles)
+    limit = min(target, max(1, k // 128), groups)
+    best = 1
+    for split in range(1, limit + 1):
+        if groups % split == 0:
+            best = split
+    return best
+
+

+def use_fp8_block32_large_tile(m: int, n: int, k: int, device_index: int = 0) -> bool:
+    """True when the 64x128 tile beats the 8-token split-K kernel on H20-3e.
+
+    The wide tile always computes 64 token rows. At M=1 that is pure waste, and
+    on the decode GEMMs it loses: wq_b is N=4096 K=1280 (8 µs vs 16 µs) and
+    wo_b is N=5120 K=1024 (7 µs vs 14 µs). Those two run every layer, so routing
+    them to the wide tile regresses TPOT even though the same tile wins prefill
+    (M≈1k, about 3×). Split-K stays on the decode side until M fills most of
+    the 64-row tile and the grid covers about half the SMs.
+    """
+    del k
+    if m < 48:
+        return False
+    tiles = ((m + 63) // 64) * ((n + 127) // 128)
+    sm = _sm_count(device_index)

+
+
+def select_fp8_block32_variant(m: int, n: int, k: int, device_index: int = 0) -> str:
+    """``64x128`` or ``m8`` for logs."""
+    if use_fp8_block32_large_tile(m, n, k, device_index):
+        return "64x128"
+    return "m8"
+

+    act: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    act_scale: torch.Tensor,

+    """64x128 block-[32, 32] GEMM. One warpgroup, four K-pipeline stages."""
+    if act.ndim == 1:

+    return out
+
+
+def fp8_block32_gemm(
+    act: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    act_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    split_k: int | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``out[M, N] = act[M, K] @ weight[N, K].T`` with block-[32, 32] fp32 scales.
+
+    ``act`` and ``weight`` are fp8 e4m3. Scales are fp32, already decoded from
+    UE8M0 when the checkpoint stores powers of two. ``weight_scale`` is
+    ``[ceil(N/32), K/32]`` and ``act_scale`` is ``[M, K/32]``. One CTA consumes
+    8 tokens; M is not limited to 1.

+    if act.ndim == 1:
+        act = act.view(1, -1)

+    assert weight.ndim == 2 and act.shape[1] == weight.shape[1]
+    m, k = act.shape
+    n = weight.shape[0]

+        device_index = act.device.index or 0

+            return fp8_block32_gemm_large(act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale)

+    assert legal_split_k(k, split_k), (k, split_k)

+    out = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=act.device)
+    # split_k == 1 stores bf16 from the mainloop; the fp32 partial is unused.
+    partial = (
+        torch.empty((split_k, m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=act.device)
+        if split_k > 1
+        else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.float32, device=act.device)
+    )
+    module = _jit_fp8_block32_sm90_module()
+    module.run(act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale, partial, out, split_k)
+    return out
+
+
+def use_fp8_block32_gemm(
+    act: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    act_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: list[int],
+    output_dtype: torch.dtype,
+) -> bool:
+    """True when this kernel should replace Triton. NVIDIA H20-3e only."""
+    if output_dtype != torch.bfloat16 or list(block_size) != [32, 32]:
+        return False
+    if act.ndim != 2 or act.shape[0] < 1 or weight.ndim != 2:
+        return False
+    if not act.is_cuda or torch.cuda.get_device_capability(act.device)[0] != 9:
+        return False
+    device_index = act.device.index if act.device.index is not None else 0
+    if not _is_h20_3e(device_index):
+        return False
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    if k % 32 != 0 or k == 0 or n == 0 or act.shape[1] != k:
+        return False
+    if act.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn or weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        return False
+    if act_scale.dtype != torch.float32 or weight_scale.dtype != torch.float32:
+        return False
+    if not act.is_contiguous() or not weight.is_contiguous():
+        return False
+    scale_k = k // 32
+    m = act.shape[0]
+    if act_scale.shape != (m, scale_k) or weight_scale.shape != (
+        (n + 31) // 32,
+        scale_k,
+    ):
+        return False
+    return act_scale.is_contiguous() and weight_scale.is_contiguous()

+"""SM90 block-[32, 32] FP8 GEMM. Serving dispatch is NVIDIA H20-3e only."""
+
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=90, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+_H20_3E = "NVIDIA H20-3e"
+
+
+def _is_h20_3e() -> bool:
+    return torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) == _H20_3E
+
+
+def _dequant_ref(act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale):
+    m, k = act.shape
+    n = weight.shape[0]
+    af = (act.float().reshape(m, k // 32, 32) * act_scale.unsqueeze(-1)).reshape(m, k)
+    pad = (32 - n % 32) % 32
+    bf = torch.nn.functional.pad(weight.float(), (0, 0, 0, pad))
+    bf = (
+        bf.reshape(-1, 32, k // 32, 32) * weight_scale.float()[:, None, :, None]
+    ).reshape(-1, k)[:n]
+    return (af @ bf.T).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _inputs(n, k, m=1, seed=0):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda")
+    g.manual_seed(seed)
+    act = (torch.randint(-8, 9, (m, k), device="cuda", generator=g) / 4).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    weight = (torch.randint(-8, 9, (n, k), device="cuda", generator=g) / 4).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    act_scale = torch.exp2(
+        torch.randint(-6, 1, (m, k // 32), device="cuda", generator=g).float()
+    )
+    weight_scale = torch.exp2(
+        torch.randint(
+            -6, 1, ((n + 31) // 32, k // 32), device="cuda", generator=g
+        ).float()
+    )
+    return act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale
+
+
+class TestFp8Block32H20Gate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_device_name_gate(self):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm import fp8_block32_sm90 as mod
+
+        for name, expected in (
+            ("NVIDIA H20-3e", True),
+            ("NVIDIA H20", False),
+            ("NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3", False),

+                mod._is_h20_3e.cache_clear()

+        mod._is_h20_3e.cache_clear()
+

+    def test_predicate_rejects_other_gpus(self):

+            _is_h20_3e,
+            use_fp8_block32_gemm,
+        )
+
+        if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 9:

+        n, k = 64, 64
+        act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale = _inputs(n, k)
+        with mock.patch(

+        ):

+
+@unittest.skipIf(

+)
+class TestFp8Block32Sm90(CustomTestCase):
+    def _check(self, n, k, split_k=None, m=1):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.fp8_block32_sm90 import fp8_block32_gemm
+
+        act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale = _inputs(n, k, m=m)
+        out = fp8_block32_gemm(act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale, split_k=split_k)
+        ref = _dequant_ref(act, weight, act_scale, weight_scale)
+        err = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs().max().item()
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(out.shape), (m, n))
+        self.assertFalse(torch.isnan(out).any().item(), (m, n, k, split_k))
+        self.assertLessEqual(err, 0.02, (m, n, k, split_k, err))
+
+    def test_shapes(self):
+        for m, n, k, split in (
+            (1, 64, 32, 1),
+            (1, 64, 64, 1),
+            (1, 64, 96, 1),
+            (1, 100, 128, 1),
+            (1, 160, 256, 2),
+            (1, 512, 5120, None),
+            (1, 5120, 288, None),
+            (1, 128, 512, None),
+            (7, 96, 64, 1),
+            (8, 128, 128, 1),
+            (16, 160, 256, 2),
+            (32, 64, 96, 1),
+            (48, 160, 128, None),
+            (96, 200, 160, None),
+            (128, 256, 256, None),
+            (130, 288, 288, None),
+            # Wide enough that the 64x128 tile is selected (M>=48 and tiles >= SMs/2).
+            (256, 4096, 256, None),
+        ):

+
+    def test_decode_stays_on_split_k(self):

+
+        # wq_b / wo_b at decode batch 1 must not take the 64-row tile.
+        self.assertFalse(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(1, 4096, 1280))
+        self.assertFalse(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(1, 5120, 1024))
+        self.assertFalse(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(32, 4096, 1280))
+        # Prefill-sized M on the same weights does.
+        self.assertTrue(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(998, 4096, 1280))
+        self.assertTrue(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(998, 5120, 1024))
+        self.assertTrue(use_fp8_block32_large_tile(4096, 5120, 5120))
+
+    def test_linear_uses_kernel_for_m_gt1(self):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.fp8_block32_sm90 import use_fp8_block32_gemm
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import (
+            sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import (
+            triton_w8a8_block_fp8_linear,
+        )
+
+        n, k = 128, 256
+        _, weight, _, weight_scale = _inputs(n, k, seed=1)
+        x = torch.randn(1, k, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        q, scale = sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8(x, 32, scale_ue8m0=True)
+        self.assertTrue(
+            use_fp8_block32_gemm(
+                q, weight, scale, weight_scale, [32, 32], torch.bfloat16
+            )

+        out = triton_w8a8_block_fp8_linear(
+            x, weight, [32, 32], weight_scale, act_scale_ue8m0=True

+        # bf16 rounding of the dequant reference can be one ulp (0.03125)
+        # on this shape; the kernel matches Triton on the same inputs.
+        self.assertLessEqual(err, 0.0625, err)

+        self.assertLessEqual(rel4.max().item(), 0.02, rel4.max().item())

+if __name__ == "__main__":

+            continue
+        block_n, block_k = block
+        table = json.loads(path.read_text())
+        assert table, f"{path.name} 是空表"
+        for m, config in table.items():
+            assert int(m) > 0, f"{path.name}: 非法 batch size {m}"
+            for msg in _invariant_violations(config, block_n, block_k):
+                problems.append(f"{path.name} M={m}: {msg}")
+            checked += 1
+    assert not problems, "配置表违反 kernel 约束：\n  " + "\n  ".join(problems[:20])
+    assert checked > 0
+
+
+def test_dsv41_block_shape_configs_are_present_for_this_device():
+    """若当前设备是 H20-3e，则 DS-V4.1 的 10 个 shape 都必须有配置表。
+
+    没有表时 `get_w8a8_block_fp8_configs` 会静默回退默认 config
+    （BLOCK_SIZE_N=32 / num_stages=3），服务启动日志里会有
+    "Config file not found ... Performance might be sub-optimal!"。
+    """
+    device = get_device_name().replace(" ", "_")
+    if device != "NVIDIA_H20-3e":
+        pytest.skip(f"当前设备 {device} 不是 H20-3e")
+    missing = [
+        (N, K)
+        for (N, K) in DSV41_SHAPES
+        if not (
+            CONFIGS_DIR
+            / f"N={N},K={K},device_name={device},dtype=fp8_w8a8,"
+            f"block_shape=[{DSV41_BLOCK_SHAPE[0]}, {DSV41_BLOCK_SHAPE[1]}].json"
+        ).is_file()
+    ]
+    assert not missing, f"H20-3e 缺少 DS-V4.1 配置表: {missing}"
+
+
+def test_config_lookup_finds_shipped_table_for_this_device():
+    """`get_w8a8_block_fp8_configs()` 必须能按真实 `get_device_name()` 找到已发布的表。
+
+    回归背景：查表文件名用的是 `get_device_name().replace(" ", "_")`。H20-3e 的
+    device name 带 `-3e` 后缀，而仓库里只有 `NVIDIA_H20` / `NVIDIA_H200` 的表 →
+    按名字查不到、静默回退默认 config。
+    """
+    device = get_device_name().replace(" ", "_")
+    candidates = [
+        p for p in _config_files()
+        if _parse_config_name(p)[2] == device and _parse_config_name(p)[3].startswith("fp8_w8a8")
+    ]
+    if not candidates:
+        pytest.skip(f"当前设备 {device} 没有随仓库发布的 fp8_w8a8 配置表")
+    N, K, _, _, (block_n, block_k) = _parse_config_name(candidates[0])
+    found = get_w8a8_block_fp8_configs(N, K, block_n, block_k)
+    assert found, (
+        f"{device} 上 N={N},K={K},block_shape=[{block_n}, {block_k}] 查表失败——"
+        "文件名与 get_device_name() 的约定不一致"
+    )
+    assert all(_invariant_violations(c, block_n, block_k) == [] for c in found.values())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.xfail(
+    reason="上游 get_configs_compute_bound() 只有 BLOCK_SIZE_K∈{64,128}，"
+           "block_k=32 过滤后为空（调优器对 DS-V4.1 的 32×32 权重不可用）；"
+           "workaround 见 benchmark 侧补候选",
+    strict=False,
+)
+def test_tuning_search_space_is_nonempty_for_every_block_k():
+    """调优器的候选集必须对每种 block_k 都非空（否则 assert best_config is not None 挂掉）。"""
+    bench_dir = REPO_ROOT / "benchmark" / "kernels" / "quantization"
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(bench_dir))
+    from tuning_block_wise_kernel import get_configs_compute_bound
+
+    space = get_configs_compute_bound()
+    for block_k in (32, 64, 128):
+        kept = [c for c in space if block_k % c["BLOCK_SIZE_K"] == 0]
+        assert kept, f"block_k={block_k} 的搜索空间为空"
+
+
+def _reference_block_fp8_matmul(A, B, As, Bs, block_n, block_k):
+    """独立参考：按 32×32 块反量化后做 fp64 matmul，再按输出 dtype 舍入。"""
+    M, K = A.shape
+    N = B.shape[0]
+    a = A.double() * As.repeat_interleave(block_k, dim=1).double()
+    b = (
+        B.double()
+        * Bs.repeat_interleave(block_n, dim=0).repeat_interleave(block_k, dim=1).double()
+    )
+    return (a @ b.T).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _dyadic_inputs(M, N, K, block_n, block_k, seed=719):
+    """用二进制可精确表示的输入，隔离 fp32 累加顺序的影响。"""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    # e4m3 能精确表示 k/4（k ∈ [-8, 8]）
+    A = (torch.randint(-8, 9, (M, K), generator=g, device="cuda") / 4).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    B = (torch.randint(-8, 9, (N, K), generator=g, device="cuda") / 4).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    # scale 取 2 的幂 → 反量化精确
+    As = torch.ldexp(
+        torch.ones(M, K // block_k, device="cuda"), -torch.randint(1, 9, (M, K // block_k), generator=g, device="cuda")
+    )
+    Bs = torch.ldexp(
+        torch.ones(N // block_n, K // block_k, device="cuda"),
+        -torch.randint(1, 9, (N // block_n, K // block_k), generator=g, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    return A, B, As, Bs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "M,N,K,block_n,block_k",
+    [
+        (1, 512, 5120, 32, 32),      # DS-V4.1 wkv（decode）
+        (64, 5120, 5120, 32, 32),    # DS-V4.1 最大 shape（decode 上限）
+        (128, 1280, 5120, 32, 32),   # DS-V4.1 wq_a
+        (33, 576, 5120, 32, 32),     # 非 2 次幂 M
+        (16, 5120, 288, 32, 32),     # K=288（K/BLOCK_SIZE_K=9，非 2 次幂）
+        (8, 256, 256, 128, 128),     # 其它 block_shape 也要能跑
+    ],
+)
+def test_block_fp8_matmul_matches_reference(M, N, K, block_n, block_k):
+    """用**配置表里的 config**跑 kernel，结果必须与独立参考一致。
+
+    这同时覆盖了"调优出来的 config 是否数值正确"——`tune()` 只看时间、不看对错，
+    BLOCK_SIZE_K 选错会让 `group_k // BLOCK_SIZE_K` 归零、结果直接错掉。
+    """
+    configs = get_w8a8_block_fp8_configs(N, K, block_n, block_k)
+    config = (
+        configs[min(configs, key=lambda m: abs(m - M))]
+        if configs
+        else {
+            "BLOCK_SIZE_M": 64,
+            "BLOCK_SIZE_N": block_n,
+            "BLOCK_SIZE_K": block_k,
+            "GROUP_SIZE_M": 32,
+            "num_warps": 4,
+            "num_stages": 3,
+        }
+    )
+    assert _invariant_violations(config, block_n, block_k) == []
+
+    A, B, As, Bs = _dyadic_inputs(M, N, K, block_n, block_k)
+    C = torch.empty((M, N), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    _w8a8_block_fp8_matmul[(triton.cdiv(M, config["BLOCK_SIZE_M"]) * triton.cdiv(N, config["BLOCK_SIZE_N"]),)](
+        A, B, C, As, Bs, M, N, K, block_n, block_k,
+        A.stride(-2), A.stride(-1), B.stride(1), B.stride(0), C.stride(-2), C.stride(-1),
+        As.stride(-2), As.stride(-1), Bs.stride(1), Bs.stride(0),
+        needs_masking=bool(K % config["BLOCK_SIZE_K"] != 0),
+        **config,
+    )
+    expected = _reference_block_fp8_matmul(A, B, As, Bs, block_n, block_k)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(C, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-s"]))
